compiled_state.title: [session-workflow]: agent edits plugin version on local main -> staged change blocks git pull
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

### Expected Behavior
Agent sessions must never modify files while checked out on local `main`. Plugin version bumps (`plugins/dso/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, VERSION files) should be made on a feature/session branch or via release.sh, never directly on main. Local main should remain clean and fast-forwardable from origin/main at all times.

### Actual Behavior
Observed in a recent session (user-reported, 2026-05-17): an agent session edited the plugin version file while HEAD was on local main. The change was left staged but uncommitted. The dirty working tree on main then blocked `git pull` from origin/main — pull refused because the staged change would be overwritten / conflict.

The session was NOT inside a sprint-active or debug-active state, so `check-session-merge-only.sh` did not fire. No other safeguard caught the violation.

### Reproduction
1. Be checked out on local main (no .sprint-active marker)
2. Run a session that edits plugin.json or VERSION
3. Observe staged-on-main state; `git pull` fails

### Suggested Investigation Direction
Two candidate gap classes (investigation should determine which apply):
1. **Hook gap**: `check-session-merge-only.sh` only fires when .sprint-active / .debug-active exist. There is no general 'no edits on main' guard for the orchestrator/main-session case.
2. **Skill/guidance gap**: skills that perform version bumps (release.sh, update-shim.sh, brainstorm/sprint helpers) may not branch off main before editing.
